gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all available screen tabs to understand the layout and organization of my Jira screens.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all screen tabs, including their IDs and names, allowing me to see how information is structured across different screens.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to fetch all tabs for a specific screen to ensure I am working with the correct fields and configurations.
gold.ideal: The API should return a detailed list of tabs for the specified screen, including their properties and associated fields.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to add a new tab to a screen to organize related fields for better user experience.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully create a new tab and return the updated list of tabs for the screen, confirming the addition.

gold.user: As an administrator, I need to remove a tab from a screen that is no longer relevant to streamline the user interface.
gold.ideal: The API should delete the specified tab and return a success message, along with the updated list of remaining tabs.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to rename a tab to better reflect its purpose and improve clarity for my team members.
gold.ideal: The API should update the tab's name and return the updated tab details, ensuring the change is reflected correctly.

gold.user: As a UI designer, I need to rearrange the order of tabs on a screen to enhance the workflow for users.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully move the specified tab to the new position and return the updated order of tabs.
